blind_target.title: Self-Censorship of Regime Support in Authoritarian States: Evidence from List Experiments in China.
blind_target.evidence_quote: We replicated previous list experiment results confirming that a majority trusts the central government despite overreports.

blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly says previous list-experiment findings were replicated. This supports the described target; novel local-government and term-limit studies are not additional targets.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract explicitly says the study replicated prior list-experiment results about majority trust in the central government despite overreports. The reference list identifies Robinson and Tannenberg (2019), whose title matches that finding. Shipped Tang (2016) is a different work and does not represent this original.
